purpose: Route-local classical/averaged/quantum energy-condition rows; energy-condition wording is necessary in some arguments but never sufficient for candidate identity.

energy_condition_rows.condition_object: Classical energy condition, averaged condition, quantum energy inequality, QNEC/QFC-adjacent bound, positivity proxy, detector/cosmology energy budget, or metadata-only condition claimed by FAMILYC-EW-CODE.
energy_condition_rows.condition_scope_rule: Declare whether the row concerns pointwise NEC/WEC/SEC/DEC, averaged null/timelike conditions, achronal ANEC, quantum energy inequalities, QNEC, QFC-adjacent bounds, positivity constraints, or an effective fluid condition. Classical pointwise conditions are not interchangeable with quantum or averaged conditions.
energy_condition_rows.violation_or_loophole_gap: Name which quantum states, boundaries, horizons, nonminimal couplings, anomalies, negative-energy windows, sampling functions, or exotic matter loopholes remain. Energy-condition wording cannot substitute for singularity/censorship, wormhole, black-hole, cosmology, or viability rows.
energy_condition_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer singularity-theorem assumptions, wormhole exclusion, censorship, stability, or physical viability from an energy-condition row unless the exact condition and domain are declared.

energy_condition_rows.condition_object: Package metadata only, with no physical energy condition or inequality.
energy_condition_rows.condition_scope_rule: Metadata does not declare NEC/WEC/SEC/DEC, ANEC, QEIs, QNEC, QFC, positivity, or effective-fluid conditions.
energy_condition_rows.violation_or_loophole_gap: No negative-energy, quantum-state, sampling, boundary, or anomaly control is supplied.
energy_condition_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer energy-condition satisfaction or route promotion from metadata/provenance.
energy_condition_rows.authority_spend_rule: For multi-route rows, this row-level S-field is a family-level envelope only; route-spendable credit is limited by route_authority_ceilings and the route state ledger.
